summary: A dotnet tool launcher is generated from the selected SDK apphost template and a relative package entry point; one fixed launcher hash is not an invariant of the package version. Authenticate the immutable package archive and complete restored execution payload, then verify the launcher against the SDK identity recorded by trusted provisioning. The verifier consumes that retained root/version/host/template-hash binding; ambient PATH discovery or a replacement template cannot establish authority. Carry the binding through offline recursion and retain the bound SDK identity in existing qualification evidence. Validate paths, ancestors and regular-file types before diagnostic reads so a symlink or special file cannot turn a refusal into an unintended read or hang. Pure relocation, untrusted-template, fake-tool and pre-read refusal controls complement the real compiler/correspondence gate; source validation alone does not establish runtime or downstream adoption.
title: Tool payload identity and provisioned SDK launcher binding are separate
